Workflows.title: Start a simulator session, verify the dashboard is usable, and view checking account activity
Workflows.goal: The bank simulator dashboard loads; The dashboard cards become interactive; The checking account activity view opens; Account Activity heading and Checking tab are visible
Workflows.starting_hint:
1. Open the simulator landing page and click GET STARTED NOW — The bank simulator dashboard loads
2. Dismiss the welcome dialog if visible — The dashboard cards become interactive
3. Click VIEW ACCOUNT on the Checking Account Activity card — The checking account activity view opens
4. Verify account activity heading and checking tab are visible — Account Activity heading and Checking tab are visible
